If you have to register

Sexual offender / predator registration
Florida’s deadlines are short. In most cases you report in person to the sheriff’s office within 48 hours of release, then update your driver license or ID at a driver license office within 48 hours after that. Your release papers and officer give your exact deadlines. Missing one is a new felony.
Your probation officer has to approve any address before you move in. State law and many cities and counties limit how close you can live to schools, child care, parks and playgrounds. Ask the officer about an address before you pay any fee. Open the Registrant resources section to search rentals, transitional homes, shelters, county housing help and support by type. Places that say they don’t take registrants are marked in red.
FDLE Registration Services: 888-357-7332 · Florida Action Committee (peer support, has a women’s group): 833-273-7325, option 1

About Cell to Sunrise

Cell to Sunrise is a Florida reentry nonprofit and app for people coming home from prison and the people helping them. Its work runs through three programs.

A safe place to land: housing, registrant housing, food and basics, transportation and health care.

Women supporting women through reentry: mentoring, peer groups, women’s programs and safety help.

Building what comes next: jobs and training, education, legal help and reentry support.

Cell to Self is the founder’s personal blog, a voice alongside this work. Link coming soon.

This guide lists outside programs to help people find options. Listing a program is not an endorsement. Always call to confirm.
